facts.control_label: proving zero energy before intrusive work

setpoint.label: re-verification interval for a long-duration isolation

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility

response.body: The proving zero energy before intrusive work shall be provided and maintained wherever this procedure applies, and its condition shall be treated as a critical control. The re-verification interval for a long-duration isolation shall be set at 72 hours. This clause applies to activities archived under ISOLATION-OF-STORED-ENERGY at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility.
